question: Edition-specific delivery and use of Kuvi materials

sources.title: Odisha-based localized digital content creation
sources.access: Complete extracted text of two-page parliamentary reply read.
sources.finding: Kuwi is listed among released primers for Odisha. The reply also describes statewide digital-content initiatives.
sources.limit: No Kuwi edition, recipient school, teacher, delivery count or Dongria-specific participation is identified. Statewide DIKSHA totals cannot measure access to Kuvi materials. Does not establish that the revised primers submitted for printing in late 2025 were printed or distributed.

sources.finding: Catalogues Dongria Kuvi at dialect level under identifier dong1300.
sources.limit: Catalogue label is not a contemporary speech survey, script-use survey or evidence that all Kuvi primers fit Dongria speech.

sources.finding: Attributes devised script to Prasanna Sree; no new usage evidence supplied.
sources.limit: Unrelated historical, geographic and educational generalisations not adopted.

editorial_decision: Existing article already distinguishes Odia-based Kuwi primer, Telugu-based Jatapu (Kuvi) primer and devised Jatapu script. Retain that explanation without padding it with another release announcement.
next_evidence_required: A dated school-level record naming the Kuwi edition and actual use
Speaker-reviewed examples linking any devised Jatapu signs to Dongria Kuvi
Printed revised edition or documented dispatch record
next_action: No repeat generic primer or script search. Next series pass should pursue turmeric processing commissioning or another unresolved concrete record.
